title: sandwich
summary: An everyday lunch with a hidden link to a town in Kent.
question: How can a food name lead to a British town?
completion: Sandwich honours the Earl of Sandwich, whose title connects it to Sandwich in Kent. This explains the food’s name; it does not establish that filled bread was invented in that town.
partner: A familiar word can carry a surprising history. Follow the evidence!
